name: check_abort: a raising check fails as itself and the next check still runs

app.name: testapp
app.checks_toml:
app = "testapp"
[checks.broken]
description = "Checks broken"
subject = "quality"
tags = ["release"]
severity = "error"
fast = true
pure = true
needs_network = false
depends_on = []

[checks.fine]
description = "Checks fine"
subject = "quality"
tags = ["release"]
severity = "error"
fast = true
pure = true
needs_network = false
depends_on = []

expect.stdout_equals:
FAIL  broken    check "broken" aborted with CheckAborted: conformance: check aborted
        [error] check "broken" aborted with CheckAborted: conformance: check aborted
PASS  fine      all good

name: check_abort: a dependent of a raising check cascade-skips

app.name: testapp
app.checks_toml:
app = "testapp"
[checks.broken]
description = "Checks broken"
subject = "quality"
tags = ["release"]
severity = "error"
fast = true
pure = true
needs_network = false
depends_on = []

[checks.dependent]
description = "Checks dependent"
subject = "quality"
tags = ["release"]
severity = "error"
fast = true
pure = true
needs_network = false
depends_on = ["broken"]

expect.stdout_equals:
FAIL  broken       check "broken" aborted with CheckAborted: conformance: check aborted
        [error] check "broken" aborted with CheckAborted: conformance: check aborted
SKIP  dependent    skipped: dependency "broken" failed
